engine.description: Which model engine the bulb uses. Default: {}.

model.description: Model id; when omitted the engine adapter picks one. No default.

effort.description: How much reasoning effort the engine spends. Default: "medium".

context.description: Extra repo context given to the engine. Default: {}.

include.description: Repo paths or globs to include as context. Default: [].

verify.description: How a change is verified before it is reported ready. Default: {}.

commands.description: Commands run locally to verify a change, in order. Default: [].

working_directory.description: Directory the verify commands run in, relative to the repo root. Default: ".".

timeout.description: How long to wait for the repo's CI checks, as <integer><unit> with unit m (minutes), h (hours) or d (days). Default: "2h".

merge.description: Merge behaviour for the bulb's PRs. Default: {}.

auto_merge.description: Whether the bulb may merge its own PRs. Default: false.

require_verified.description: Whether a PR must pass verification before it is reported ready or merged. Default: true.

notify.description: Where and when the owner is notified. Default: {}.

webhook.description: Webhook URL, or a secret reference such as ${{ secrets.NAME }}; kept as an opaque string. No default.

on.description: Lifecycle events and outcomes that trigger a notification. Default: ["ready", "blocked", "error"].

responsibilities.description: The responsibilities this bulb has; a responsibility is configured when its key is present. At least one is required.

dep-updates.description: Keep dependencies up to date with grouped patch and minor bumps. No default.

enabled.description: Whether this responsibility runs. Default: true.

schedule.description: How often the bulb wakes to check for updates. Default: "weekly".

directories.description: Directories (relative to the repo root) whose manifests and lockfiles may be edited. Default: ["."].

allow.description: Update kinds included in the grouped PR; majors always get their own PR. Default: ["patch", "minor"].

min_release_age.description: Minimum age of a release before it is picked up, as <integer><unit> with unit m (minutes), h (hours) or d (days); 0d means no waiting. Default: "7d".

hold.description: Packages held back, mapped to the reason they are held. Default: {}.

group.description: How patch and minor bumps are grouped into one PR. Default: "weekly".

vuln-patch.description: Patch known vulnerabilities in dependencies. No default.

enabled.description: Whether this responsibility runs. Default: true.

directories.description: Directories (relative to the repo root) whose manifests and lockfiles may be edited. Default: ["."].

ci-fix.description: Fix failing CI checks on PRs another responsibility opened, within that responsibility's directories. No default.

enabled.description: Whether this responsibility runs. Default: true.

attempts.description: Maximum fix attempts per PR, 1 to 100. Default: 2.

max_diff_lines.description: Maximum changed lines in one fix. Default: 200.

budget.description: Per-task limits, summed across wake-ups. Default: {}.

per_task_cad.description: Maximum model spend per task, in Canadian dollars. Default: 1.

per_task_minutes.description: Maximum runner wall time per task, in minutes (CI waiting not counted). Default: 15.

safety.description: Safety limits the runner enforces. Default: {}.

never_touch.description: Path globs the bulb never reads into context or edits. Default: [".env*", "**/secrets/**"].

never_push_default_branch.description: Never push to the default branch. Default: true.

never_force_push.description: Never force-push, except to bulb/* branches the bulb opened. Default: true.

workflow_files.description: How workflow files are treated; bulbs never edit them. Default: "blocked".
